skill_title: Calculate percentages and percentage of value
notes: 20-item bank. CAPS mix: 5 L1 / 8 L2 / 7 L3. Topics: % of amount, % increase, % decrease, VAT (15%), discount, deposit. SA contexts: Pick n Pay sale, geyser deposit, restaurant tip, SARS-style VAT.

stimulus.inline: x% of an amount = x ÷ 100 × amount.

items.question: Calculate 10% of R200.

stimulus.inline: Multiply percentages by amounts the same way as any fraction-of calculation.

items.question: Calculate 25% of R400.

stimulus.inline: VAT in South Africa is 15%.

items.question: Calculate 15% VAT on R200.

stimulus.inline: A 5% discount means 5% off the price.

items.question: Calculate the discount amount on R600 at 5% off.

stimulus.inline: Find the percentage one number is of another by dividing and × 100.

items.question: What percentage of R200 is R50?

stimulus.inline: A school tracksuit costs R800. The shop offers a 15% discount.

items.question: Calculate the sale price.

stimulus.inline: A till slip shows a subtotal of R450,00 before VAT. VAT is 15%.

items.question: Calculate the total payable including VAT.

stimulus.inline: A restaurant bill is R420. Sipho wants to leave a 10% tip.

items.question: Calculate the tip amount.

stimulus.inline: A geyser costs R6 500. The store requires a 20% deposit.

items.question: Calculate the deposit amount.

stimulus.inline: A class of 40 learners includes 24 girls.

items.question: What percentage of the class are girls?

stimulus.inline: Mr Naidoo's monthly salary is R18 000. He receives a 6% raise.

items.question: Calculate his new monthly salary.

stimulus.inline: A jersey marked R450 is reduced by 30% in a sale.

items.question: Calculate the sale price.

stimulus.inline: A learner scored 42 out of 60 on a maths test.

items.question: Convert this to a percentage.

stimulus.inline:
**Builders Warehouse till slip (VAT-exclusive prices)**

| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| Tin of paint | 380,00 |
| Roller | 75,00 |
| 3 paint brushes | 45,00 |

VAT 15% added at till.

items.question: Calculate the VAT-inclusive total.

stimulus.inline: A microwave is on sale at 20% off, and a further 10% loyalty discount applies on the sale price. Original price: R1 800.

items.question: Calculate the final price after both discounts.

stimulus.inline: Eskom raises its tariff by 8% effective 1 July. Previous price was R3,20/kWh.

items.question: Calculate the new tariff to the nearest cent.

stimulus.inline: Lerato earns R8 500 per month. She saves 12% of her salary every month.

items.question: Calculate how much she has saved after 6 months.

stimulus.inline: A car dealership advertises a vehicle at R245 000 (VAT inclusive).

items.question: Calculate the VAT-exclusive price. Round to the nearest Rand.

stimulus.inline: A small business reports profit of R45 000 on revenue of R250 000.

items.question: Calculate the profit margin as a percentage of revenue.

stimulus.inline: A learner needs at least 50% in Maths Lit to pass. The paper is out of 150 marks.

items.question: What is the minimum number of marks she needs?

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_BASE_INVERTED: Divides the larger by the smaller (or vice versa) when finding what % one number is of another.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_INCREASE: Forgets to add the increase back to the original (gives the increase amount instead of the new value).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_DECREASE: Forgets to subtract the discount from the original (gives the discount amount instead of the sale price).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_SUCCESSIVE_ADD: Adds two successive percentage changes (e.g. treats 20% + 10% as 30% off).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_REVERSE_NAIVE: Computes 15% of an inclusive total and subtracts (instead of dividing by 1,15) when reversing VAT.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_VAT_RATE: Uses the wrong VAT rate (14% old rate, or 10%).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_ROUND_NEAREST_RULE: Misapplies the rounding rule on the final answer.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_USE_OPERATION: Uses the wrong operation when applying a known rate.
